paths.description: Localized homepage and consent/browse entry archetype; desktop, mobile, preferences, performance, network, security, discoverability, and memory checks.
Category/index archetype representing taxonomy navigation and dense listing layout.
Representative media-detail and legal age/login-gated viewing journey.
Primary account-creation surface representing authentication and disclosure.
Synthetic missing route representing HTTP/application recovery state.

Not covered: authenticated playback, account management, payment/subscription completion, and every locale variant because no credentials/payment consent were available and sampled pages represent shared templates.

findings.summary: Motion preference is ignored by loading shimmers
findings.evidence: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, getAnimations() still reported eight running shimmer animations, each with a 2000 ms duration.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable or simplify non-essential shimmer/preview motion inside prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: Key text fails contrast requirements
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found 13 insufficient-contrast nodes, including 2.15:1 and 1.75:1 text in the age banner; no prefers-contrast rules were found. The forced-colors capture attempt received an external 503.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase foreground/background contrast and add explicit forced-colors/prefers-contrast treatment.

findings.summary: Route changes are abrupt
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection found no view-transition CSS or route-transition implementation; representative navigation is a full abrupt document change.
findings.suggestedFix: Use cross-document View Transitions with a reduced-motion fallback for stable shared chrome.

findings.summary: Navigation chrome does not respond to scroll
findings.evidence: Home and category screenshots show large static header, banner, and side navigation chrome; CSS inspection found no scroll-state query or progress treatment.
findings.suggestedFix: Use scroll-state-aware shrinking or progressive chrome where long lists are browsed.

findings.summary: Navigation does not cue destination changes
findings.evidence: Representative route changes provide no transition, focus handoff, or destination highlight; screenshots show abrupt replacement while static chrome dominates.
findings.suggestedFix: Move focus to the destination heading and optionally use directional transitions.

findings.summary: Consent UI obscures the initial content
findings.evidence: The initial desktop viewport is obscured by a large cookie modal before interaction, while age-verification and promotional banners also occupy the underlying first viewport.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep required consent concise, semantically modal, immediately keyboard-operable, and content-respecting.

findings.summary: Cookie modal is a non-semantic custom div
findings.evidence: DOM inspection found the cookie surface as a custom div.experimentalModalContainer with no dialog element or role=dialog; the page had zero dialog elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement it with dialog/showModal, an accessible name, focus containment, Escape policy, and explicit choices.

findings.summary: Promotional and navigation chrome crowds the content
findings.evidence: Desktop/mobile screenshots show stacked header, age-verification banner, sale banner, persistent category rail, inline promotions, and consent UI competing with the media content.
findings.suggestedFix: Collapse secondary chrome on small screens and separate/promote the core browse task.

findings.summary: Mobile layout remains desktop-width
findings.evidence: At a 360 px visual viewport, layout reported scrollWidth 1036 and 676 px horizontal overflow; the mobile screenshot visibly clips the content column.
findings.suggestedFix: Correct mobile layout selection and use fluid intrinsic widths so scrollWidth never exceeds the visual viewport.

findings.summary: Components do not adapt to their container
findings.evidence: Computed layout at mobile retained a 1024 px body/main and inspection found no @container rules, so reused page chrome does not adapt to its available container.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce component containment and @container breakpoints for header, rail, cards, and signup shell.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus and touch targeting are inadequate
findings.evidence: Focused search input matched :focus-visible but computed outline was none and box-shadow none; Lighthouse also found two undersized/obscured targets.
findings.suggestedFix: Add strong :focus-visible styling and enforce at least 24x24 CSS px targets with spacing, preferably 44x44.

findings.summary: Largest content paint misses the good range
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 3.0 s (outside the good <=2.5 s range) and FCP 2.9 s; CLS was 0 and TBT 0 ms in that run.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce document latency and prioritize the LCP asset and critical styles.

findings.summary: Long main-thread tasks occur after load
findings.evidence: The trace recorded two long tasks, longest 170.75 ms, and 145.04 ms total blocking time; mobile layout observation independently recorded 62 ms and 144 ms tasks.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the 61-script workload and split/defer work into prioritized sub-50 ms tasks.

findings.summary: Render-blocking and cache delivery delay content
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 1220 ms savings from five render-blocking stylesheets and 115 KiB from cache lifetime improvements; HAR recorded 140 requests.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline only critical CSS, defer noncritical styles, and extend immutable cache lifetimes for versioned assets.

findings.summary: Unused and legacy code is shipped
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 58 KiB unused CSS, 26 KiB unused JS, and 11 KiB legacy JavaScript; HAR recorded 61 scripts and about 1.01 MB script transfer.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split by page archetype and remove unused/legacy branches from the modern bundle.

findings.summary: Controls and links lack robust accessible names/roles
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found one unnamed button, two unnamed links, nine label/name mismatches, and invalid list semantics; image inspection found one missing alt.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every control a matching accessible name and repair list/role semantics.

findings.summary: Text contrast is insufficient
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found 13 contrast failures, including age-banner text at 2.15:1 and 1.75:1 and metadata text at 3.29:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust design tokens to meet WCAG AA in every theme and state.

findings.summary: Focus and document structure are unreliable
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found malformed list structure and inappropriate roles; direct keyboard-focus probing found no visible outline or shadow on the focused search field.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore semantic lists/landmarks and provide visible, ordered keyboard focus.

findings.summary: Text and controls do not reflow on narrow screens
findings.evidence: At 360 px the page keeps a 1036 px content width, clipping headings, navigation, cards, and signup content outside the viewport and harming readable reflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Use fluid typography and intrinsic wrapping inside a true single-column mobile layout.

findings.summary: Zoom, target size, and media alternatives are incomplete
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports user-scalable=no in the audited mobile viewport and two target-size failures; video DOM exposed no caption tracks in the gated player state.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove user-scalable=no, enlarge targets, and provide caption/equivalent tracks for playable media.

findings.summary: Image markup wastes bytes and risks instability
findings.evidence: Document has HTML doctype and UTF-8, but image inspection found 29 of 36 images missing dimensions and 13 oversized; Lighthouse independently found unsized images.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width/height or aspect-ratio and tighten srcset/sizes to rendered card sizes.

findings.summary: Public pages are not mobile-friendly
findings.evidence: Links and viewport meta are present and robots permits public pages, but the 360 px layout overflows by 676 px, so the mobile-friendly part fails directly.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix responsive reflow before treating these URLs as mobile-friendly.

findings.summary: Indexing signals are inconsistent
findings.evidence: Home returned 200 and has a canonical, but it points to id.xhamster.com rather than the audited id.xhname.com host; /sitemap.xml returned 404 and no hreflang links were present despite many locale variants.
findings.suggestedFix: Choose a canonical host consistently, publish sitemap indexes, and emit reciprocal hreflang for locale pages.

findings.summary: Rich pages lack structured/share metadata
findings.evidence: The home page is a rich media listing, but DOM inspection found zero JSON-LD blocks and zero Open Graph tags.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate VideoObject/ItemList and Open Graph metadata matching visible content.

findings.summary: Transport policy and cookies are incompletely hardened
findings.evidence: HTTPS/HSTS are present, but CSP is only frame-ancestors self; nosniff and Referrer-Policy are missing, and two first-party cookies lack Secure.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive nonce/hash CSP, nosniff, strict referrer policy, and Secure/SameSite cookie attributes.

findings.summary: The anonymous page has a broad cross-origin footprint
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 116 of 140 requests and 1.60 MB of 1.79 MB transfer on non-page origins; tracker probe enumerated 16 third-party origins including Google accounts and an ad syndication origin.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit each origin, defer optional integrations until consent/need, and batch telemetry.

findings.summary: Authentication does not expose phishing-resistant sign-in
findings.evidence: No permission prompt fired on load, but the relevant signup flow exposes Google, X, or email and no passkey/WebAuthn option or navigator.credentials use was observed.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey registration/authentication alongside account recovery and request permissions only in context.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policies are weak
findings.evidence: HSTS and clickjacking defenses are present, but Referrer-Policy and nosniff are absent, CSP lacks script restrictions, and Permissions-Policy only configures UA client hints.
findings.suggestedFix: Harden CSP and Permissions-Policy, add Referrer-Policy/nosniff, and retain HSTS/frame defenses.

findings.summary: Localized pages retain English and non-locale number formatting
findings.evidence: Rendered Indonesian copy mixes non-localized abbreviations and English labels such as 108.6M tampilan, More Videos, and Choose your porn category rather than locale-aware Indonesian formatting.
findings.suggestedFix: Format numbers through Intl.NumberFormat and complete message-catalog localization.

findings.summary: Commercial cards are weakly distinguished from organic content
findings.evidence: The content list interleaves third-party and subscription promotions with ordinary media cards; screenshots show the sale banner and in-feed commercial content competing with organic results, with weak ad distinction.
findings.suggestedFix: Label ads/sponsored content persistently and visually separate commercial modules from organic results.

findings.summary: Image assets are oversized or legacy
findings.evidence: Image inspection found 13 oversized images, 15 legacy-format images, 29 missing dimensions, and three without responsive sources.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve tightly sized AVIF/WebP variants with accurate srcset/sizes and dimensions.

findings.summary: The page ships wasteful work
findings.evidence: The home load makes 140 requests including 61 scripts; Lighthouse identifies substantial unused CSS/JS and the trace records long tasks after load.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer below-fold and optional modules and remove unused work.

findings.summary: Third-party and script budget is disproportionate
findings.evidence: The page transfers 1.79 MB; 1.60 MB and 116 requests are attributed to non-page origins, with 1.01 MB of scripts and 16 third-party origins.
findings.suggestedFix: Set origin/script budgets, lazy-load optional promotions, and cache or remove low-value dependencies.

taskList.title: Repair true mobile reflow and component responsiveness
Fix accessible names, semantics, focus, contrast, zoom, and targets
Harden CSP, cookies, and browser security policies
Reduce blocking, unused, and cross-origin script work
Rebuild consent as a semantic, less intrusive dialog
Correct image sizing and responsive delivery
Improve metadata, localization, and commercial labeling
Respect reduced motion and add navigational continuity
